about.title: About
about.subtitle: A tool for recording Mahjong games, tracking stats, and syncing multiplayer tables
about.section.usage.title: Usage & Disclaimer
about.section.usage.body:
This app is a score tracking tool only.
It does NOT provide gambling or betting services.
It does NOT involve real-money transactions.
It does NOT connect to any external gambling platforms.
about.section.privacy.title: Data & Privacy
about.section.privacy.body:
Solo games, settings, and local archives stay on your device and work offline.
Rooms you choose to create or join are synced through Firebase.
No advertising or tracking SDK is built in.
about.section.meta.title: Version Info
about.noGambling: This app is for score tracking and analysis only. It does not provide gambling or real-money services.
